Scope: Read-only inspection of the registered Windows 11 ISO for Telnet optional-feature source metadata

Inspection.Method: Read-only file metadata and direct fixed-offset reads of ISO volume descriptors plus its ISO9660 primary directory; no servicing APIs or mount operation.
Inspection.PrimaryVolumeDescriptor: ISO9660 descriptor present at logical sector 16.

Finding: This ISO stores its useful directory tree in UDF; the ISO9660 primary root does not expose sources/sxs, so no Telnet package identity or matching CAB was established. Do not treat this as proof the media lacks the component.

ExternalGuidance.Limit: Official feature-media guidance does not identify the exact TelnetClient package identity in this image; keep the code guard until package metadata is observed from matching media.

Deferred: Telnet LocalSource validation requires identifying the actual matching optional-feature source package; the registered ISO payload remains unenumerated without an approved UDF read path.
